name: Тёмный оракул
essence: A moody, mythic social-handle promo that strings rapid symbolic tableaux (skull, eye coin, evolution, sphinx) across charcoal and burnt-orange fields before collapsing into a centred handle lockup. The grammar is fast cuts between iconic centred emblems under a persistent corner watermark, then a slow, dark, glowing end card.
material_and_look: Near-black charcoal fields with heavy vignettes and soft halos, interrupted by one pale grey flash frame and a sunset-orange disc that glows like a moon. Grainy, aged, cinematic texture with a soft inner-glow edge.
colour_logic: Charcoal dominates, burnt orange #e87838 is the single warm accent that becomes the sun or portal, and one light-grey inversion frame punctuates the sequence early. The end card shifts the accent into a gradient icon before it resolves to pure white.
type_and_layout: Minimal condensed uppercase handle text in white, small in the top-right corner as a persistent watermark, later migrating left and finally centred and enlarged beneath an icon. Visuals are centred emblems, vertical slit panels, and mirrored triangles framing a central figure.
motion_quality: Most shots hold almost still with slow drift and halo pulse, while energy comes from cuts at about 2 per second and one glitch-smear transition. The tiny figure leaping across the disc adds the only character motion.
camera_and_transitions: Hard cuts, one light/dark inversion flash, a datamosh-style glitch smear, and a slow push into the final lockup. A vertical orange slit opens like a doorway before expanding to full frame.
sound: Dark cinematic drone with sub hits on each cut and a swelling riser into the handle reveal. A soft whoosh or impact lands as the icon appears.
